description: Resolve an attachment to its absolute path on this machine, so the file can be opened and read directly. Works for both linked and imported attachments. Passing a regular item key returns the paths of all of its file attachments. Use this to read a PDF whose text Zotero has not indexed.

groupId.description: Group library ID. Omit for the personal library ("My Library"), which is what almost every request wants. Group IDs come from zotero_list_libraries.

itemKey.description: Attachment key, or a parent item key to resolve all of its attachments.

name: zotero_get_attachment_path
title: Get an attachment file path
